title: What If It Never Stopped Raining Food?
description:
One Tuesday at 12:14 PM, it starts raining french fries over Gus's school. Every day the food gets better, the town goes crazy, and nobody asks why. Except the girl with the pink bow, who figures out something nobody wants to hear: it's not weather. It's grading us.
By day six, the sky stops being nice.

Gus doesn't talk much. He wears orange headphones, eats the same cheese sandwich every day, and somehow keeps ending up inside the weirdest "what if" situations in town. Lia, the girl with the pink bow, is usually the only one who notices.
